description: This file defines a static internal class `MessagingInstruments` responsible for collecting and reporting various messaging metrics in the Orleans runtime, such as message sizes, counts of sent/received/dropped messages, ping statistics, and message lifecycle events.

classes.name: MessagingInstruments
classes.description: A static class providing static methods and counters to monitor messaging metrics within the Orleans system.

methods.name: OnMessageExpired
methods.description: Records an expired message event, categorized by phase.

methods.name: OnPingSend
methods.description: Records a ping send event to a specified destination address.

methods.name: OnPingReceive
methods.description: Records a ping received event from a specified destination address.

methods.name: OnPingReplyReceived
methods.description: Records a ping reply received event from a replier address.

methods.name: OnPingReplyMissed
methods.description: Records a missed ping reply from a replier address.

methods.name: OnFailedSentMessage
methods.description: Records a failed message send event.

methods.name: OnMessageReceive
methods.description: Records message reception, including size and connection info.

methods.name: OnMessageSend
methods.description: Records message sending, including size and connection info.
